## Factor Score Norming — Overview

<div style="font-size: 0.6em; line-height: 1.3;">
The raw factor score `F` is put through a **three-stage normalization pipeline**,
estimated in the HCAP normative subsample (`normexcld == 0`) and then applied to
the full HRS 2016 sample:

1. **Blom transformation** — maps `F` to a normal score (`f_blom`) within the
   normative sample; a cubic spline model (knots at 5th, 35th, 65th, 95th %iles
   of `F`) is used to apply the transformation portably to the full sample

2. **Demographic adjustment** — survey-weighted GLM regresses the Blom-transformed
   score on age splines (RCS centered at 70), sex, race/ethnicity, and years of
   schooling, plus two-way interactions (R² ≈ 0.37); fitted values = `Eblom`

3. **T-scaling** — standardized residual rescaled to mean = 50, SD = 10:

$$TF = 50 + 10 \times \frac{\text{Pblom} - \text{Eblom}}{\text{SEE}}$$

`TF` reflects **demographically-adjusted cognitive performance** relative to the
normative HCAP sample.
</div>

## Cut Points: Pre-specified Selection

```{r a8-cuts}
#| include: false
a8_cal <- readRDS(here::here("R_objects", "A7_070_threshold_calibration.rds"))
a8_sel <- a8_cal$selected
a8_pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x)
a8_pts <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f", 100 * x)
```

<div style="font-size: 0.6em; line-height: 1.3;">
Rule fixed on 2026-10-21, before any result was seen (`R/A7_070`):

- **Score:** T rounded to an integer, TR = floor(TF + 0.5); integer cut points
- **Candidates:** every pair, severe `r min(a8_cal$spec$severe_range)`–`r max(a8_cal$spec$severe_range)`, moderate `r min(a8_cal$spec$moderate_range)`–`r max(a8_cal$spec$moderate_range)`; memory and IQCODE rules fixed
- **Eligible:** weighted dementia share within `r a8_pts(a8_cal$spec$tol_dementia)` points and MCI share within `r a8_pts(a8_cal$spec$tol_mci)` points of Manly-Jones (HRS-HCAP Wave 1, n = `r format(a8_cal$n_sample, big.mark = ",")`)
- **Choose:** highest weighted dementia kappa; ties to highest 3-class kappa

**Result:** TR < `r a8_cal$cuts[["severe"]]` (severe) and TR < `r a8_cal$cuts[["moderate"]]` (moderate); `r nrow(a8_cal$eligible)` eligible pairs (stage: `r a8_cal$selection_stage`)

| | Normal | MCI | Dementia | Kappa (dementia) | Kappa (3-class) |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| Manly-Jones | `r a8_pct(a8_cal$target_shares[["1"]])` | `r a8_pct(a8_cal$target_shares[["2"]])` | `r a8_pct(a8_cal$target_shares[["3"]])` | | |
| Core, selected | `r a8_pct(a8_sel$share_normal)` | `r a8_pct(a8_sel$share_mci)` | `r a8_pct(a8_sel$share_dementia)` | `r sprintf("%.3f", a8_sel$kappa_binary)` | `r sprintf("%.3f", a8_sel$kappa_3class)` |

`r if (!is.null(a8_cal$bootstrap)) paste0("Bootstrap (", a8_cal$bootstrap$n_boot, " design-based samples): same pair selected in ", a8_pct(a8_cal$bootstrap$pct_same_pair), ". ") else ""`Kappas are in-sample. Previous cut points (T < 37, T < 48) had no documented derivation.
</div>
